data.body: Already fixed on main. `infra/gerrit/materialize-deploy-key.sh` was added to autodeploy CONFIG_PATHS under bug 408c-9c78-c523-4d1c (commit f87719be9999, 'fix(autodeploy): add 2 sources to path manifests', autodeploy.sh:217). Regression test tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_signals_gerrit_config.py:47 asserts this path and names bug 408c; a derive-and-diff structural guard (scripts/check_deploy_manifest.py + tests/unit/test_check_deploy_manifest.py:39, ticket 0a6a-04d3-8fd9-4cd5) also covers it. This detect-only-drift sibling was fixed in the same class fix as 5025/8053. Closing as duplicate of 408c.
